methodology: Frozen observations; rerunning calculations does not refresh sources. Date cutoffs differ by metric. Current Dune embeds can differ. No causal or tokenholder-income claim.

sources.extraction: CSV produced by saved capital collector: TVL=tvl; stablecoins=sum(totalCirculatingUSD values), keyed by UTC date. This bundle validates the CSV, not underlying onchain balances.

defi-capital.headline: DeFi capital fell 9.8% over 30 days.
defi-capital.limitation: USD changes reflect prices and balances, not net deposits. The ending date was captured intraday and may be revised.

calculation.method: (ending balance / starting balance - 1) × 100

stablecoins.headline: Stablecoin circulating value rose 49.9% over 30 days.
stablecoins.limitation: Circulating value is a balance, not transfer volume; it can overlap DeFi TVL. The ending date was captured intraday and may be revised.

calculation.method: (ending balance / starting balance - 1) × 100

intents-volume.headline: Reported Intents volume averaged $133.3m a day.
intents-volume.limitation: Cross-chain service notional, not NEAR L1 settlement or NEAR token demand.

calculation.method: Sum daily volume for 30 dates; divide by 30 for daily average

intents-fees.headline: Reported gross service fees over 30 completed UTC days.
intents-fees.limitation: Not tokenholder revenue. The saved Dune aggregate is $6.53m with an unverified reporting window; it is not a reconciled same-period comparison.

calculation.method: Sum API dailyFees for 30 completed UTC dates. Retain saved Dune aggregate separately; its reporting window is unverified.

defi-mix.headline: Rhea Lend and Rhea Dex account for 96.7% of tracked balances.
defi-mix.limitation: Share of the tracked product roster, not unique deposited dollars; intraday composition differs from daily chain TVL.

calculation.method: Sum named balances / sum all tracked balances × 100

stablecoin-mix.headline: USDC and USDT account for 98.6% of tracked balances.
stablecoin-mix.limitation: Price-adjusted tracked balances; native and bridged forms may be aggregated.

calculation.method: Sum named balances / sum all tracked balances × 100

chain-mix.headline: The Ethereum label accounts for 45.9% of reported Intents volume.
chain-mix.limitation: Provider chain labels, not proof of NEAR L1 settlement or independent users.

calculation.method: Sum named labels / sum all labels × 100

token-mix.headline: USDT and USDC account for 63.3% of reported Intents volume.
token-mix.limitation: Provider token-symbol labels may combine distinct assets or contracts.

calculation.method: Sum named labels / sum all labels × 100

distribution.headline: The swapkit label accounts for 56.8% of distribution fees.
distribution.limitation: Fee share, not volume or user share. Referral labels are not beneficial-owner identities; excludes separate protocol fees.

calculation.method: Sum named labels / sum all labels × 100

base-activity.headline: Observed transactions per day across seven completed UTC dates.
base-activity.limitation: Receipt-date transaction counts include all outcomes. A transaction can appear on multiple dates; origin accounts include relayers, not people.

calculation.method: Deduplicate transaction hashes per receipt-execution date; average seven daily counts

total-supply.headline: Total native supply at the observed finalized block.
total-supply.limitation: Total supply is not circulating, unlocked or liquid supply. One RPC observation; no independent provider reconciliation.

calculation.method: Finalized block header total_supply / 10^24; pin block_id to reproduce

ir-fees.headline: Fees generated across the last 30 completed source dates.
ir-fees.limitation: NEAR-equivalent provider accounting: wallet receipts plus the source’s gas-burn classification. Not tokenholder cash income or independently verified buybacks.

calculation.method: Sum daily Intents fees + protocol fees across the stated 30-date window. The separately reported 30-day KPI differs; its window is not reconciled.

ir-revenue.headline: Captured revenue over 30 completed source dates.
ir-revenue.limitation: NEAR-equivalent provider accounting: wallet receipts plus the source’s gas-burn classification. Not tokenholder cash income or independently verified buybacks.

calculation.method: Sum daily Intents receipts + provider-classified gas burn across the stated window. The separately reported 30-day KPI differs; its window is not reconciled.

ir-fee-sources.headline: Intents accounts for this share of cumulative fees in NEAR equivalents.
ir-fee-sources.limitation: NEAR-equivalent provider accounting: wallet receipts plus the source’s gas-burn classification. Not tokenholder cash income or independently verified buybacks.

calculation.method: Cumulative Intents fees / cumulative total fees × 100.

ir-cumulative.headline: Cumulative captured revenue, alongside total fees of 34.98m NEAR.
ir-cumulative.limitation: NEAR-equivalent provider accounting: wallet receipts plus the source’s gas-burn classification. Not tokenholder cash income or independently verified buybacks.

calculation.method: Sum each daily revenue component across the complete source history.

ir-emissions.headline: Latest daily issuance exceeded captured revenue by this amount.
ir-emissions.limitation: NEAR-equivalent provider accounting: wallet receipts plus the source’s gas-burn classification. Not tokenholder cash income or independently verified buybacks.

calculation.method: Daily emissions − daily captured revenue. This accounting comparison is not net supply issuance.

ir-coverage.headline: Captured revenue covered this share of issuance across 30 source dates.
ir-coverage.limitation: NEAR-equivalent provider accounting: wallet receipts plus the source’s gas-burn classification. Not tokenholder cash income or independently verified buybacks.

calculation.method: Sum revenue / sum emissions × 100; not the average of daily percentages.

ir-wallets.headline: Intents receipts dominate the source’s trailing-year revenue mix.
ir-wallets.limitation: NEAR-equivalent provider accounting: wallet receipts plus the source’s gas-burn classification. Not tokenholder cash income or independently verified buybacks.

calculation.method: Named wallet classification / sum all revenue wallet classifications × 100.
calculation.label: Intents Revenue (fefundsadmin + 1csfundsadmin)

ir-transactions.headline: Transactions on the latest completed source date.
ir-transactions.limitation: Provider-reported base-chain transactions, not unique users or Intents swaps.

calculation.method: Read the latest daily Transactions observation.

ir-accounts.headline: Active accounts on the latest completed source date.
ir-accounts.limitation: Accounts can include bots, relayers and multiple identities belonging to one entity.

calculation.method: Read the latest daily Active Accounts observation; do not sum daily counts into monthly unique accounts.

ir-gas.headline: Base-chain gas fees on the latest completed source date.
ir-gas.limitation: Native gas fees only; separate from cross-chain Intents service fees.

calculation.method: Read the latest Gas Fees observation, denominated in NEAR.

ir-price.headline: NEAR’s price at the source cutoff.
ir-price.limitation: A historical provider price, not a live quote or a valuation conclusion.

calculation.method: Read the latest Price observation, denominated in USD.

ir-supply.headline: The gap between total and circulating supply at the source cutoff.
ir-supply.limitation: Provider supply definitions; the difference is not a verified vesting or tradable-float estimate.

calculation.method: Total Supply − Circulating Supply on the same source date.

ir-volume.headline: Intents trading notional on the latest completed source date.
ir-volume.limitation: Cross-chain service volume, not NEAR L1 settlement or token demand.

calculation.method: Read the latest Daily Volume observation in USD.

ir-swaps.headline: Intents swaps on the latest completed source date.
ir-swaps.limitation: Swaps are not users. The source’s totalSwaps and cumulativeSwaps fields disagree.

calculation.method: Read the latest Daily Swaps observation; cumulative fields are not used.

ir-intents-fees.headline: Intents service fees on the latest completed source date.
ir-intents-fees.limitation: Gross service fees in USD, not revenue paid to NEAR holders.

calculation.method: Read the latest Daily Fees observation in USD.

ir-chains.headline: ETH is the largest blockchain label in the 30-day Intents volume mix.
ir-chains.limitation: Token and blockchain mixes describe the same activity; do not add them. Labels are provider-defined, not verified entities.

calculation.method: Sum named label volume / sum all labels × 100 over the stated 30-day window.
calculation.label: ETH

ir-tokens.headline: USDT is the largest token label in the 30-day Intents volume mix.
ir-tokens.limitation: Token and blockchain mixes describe the same activity; do not add them. Labels are provider-defined, not verified entities.

calculation.method: Sum named label volume / sum all labels × 100 over the stated 30-day window.
calculation.label: USDT

ir-channels.headline: swapkit accounts for this share of reported channel fees.
ir-channels.limitation: All-time referral-fee mix, not user or volume share. Its total differs from the source’s total Intents fees.

calculation.method: Named channel fees / sum all reported channel fees × 100.
calculation.label: swapkit
